share.heading: Share '{name}'
share.permissions_note: Without SELECT they cannot see the tables at all. Changing the structure (CREATE, ALTER, DROP) stays with you. They get a database login of their own that holds just this, so your password never leaves this computer.
share.load_failed:
Could not load the sharing details:
{error}
share.reload_failed:
Could not reload who has access:
{error}
share.no_username: Enter the username of the person to invite.
share.invited: Invited {username} to {permissions}. They accept it under Invitations.
share.revoked_not_in_database:
{username} no longer has {permission} here, but the database still allows it: {error}
It is taken away the next time you open the database.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.intro: Databases other users share with you. Accepting adds the database to your list; what you may do there is what its owner offered.

premium.title: Premium
premium.intro_active:
Premium is active, verified with {email}.
To connect a different address, verify it below.
premium.intro_registered:
Premium lets you share your databases with other users.
Send a code to the address you registered with - or type another one.
premium.intro_new:
Premium lets you share your databases with other users.
Verify an email address to upgrade - it is not used for anything else.
premium.bad_code: The code is the six digits from the email.
premium.upgraded:
Your account is premium now.
Use Share next to one of your databases to invite someone.
